ad_info.structure_source: library format F42 (Línea de tiempo de 3 meses ilustrada con oferta de tratamiento)
ad_info.reference_style: Flat vector illustration timeline ad (three monthly panels of the same woman) with the real bottles and an offer block

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (highlighted headline word, accents), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (headline and offer text), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, seal gold #D4A437 only for the registration badge border. Secondary support colors for this variation: lavender #B9A6E0 (background) and butter yellow #FFE08A (month tags and the December sweater).
global_identity.visual_style: Flat vector illustration with clean outlines for the woman and the decor; the three bottles are the real photographic bottle, sharp and identical to the product photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Friendly, hopeful, December holiday mood, light and modern.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat shapes, thin dark outlines, small flat holiday stars, rounded month tags, a pink ribbon swirl behind the bottles, a white offer card and a round gold-bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; small colloquial line, value proposition and offer in Poppins SemiBold / Bold look.

creative_objective: Turn the three bottles into a real three-month plan: the same woman illustrated in December, January and February, her legs going from thin and lost in loose jeans to toned and filling them, with the three real bottles and the treatment offer underneath.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Headline with 'CURVAS' in fuchsia; 2) the three monthly illustrations; 3) the three real bottles and the offer card; 4) value proposition and trust items.
art_direction.composition_style: Top text band, a middle row of three equal illustrated panels, a bottom band split into bottles on the left and the offer card on the right, with a slim trust strip at the very bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Three panels with equal 20 px gutters, generous padding around text, offer card aligned with the bottles.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration lighting for the panels; soft studio light with a contact shadow for the real bottles.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 24%: a big two-line headline and the value proposition (the small colloquial line of the structure is left out). Middle 40%: three equal flat illustrations of the same woman, one per month (DICIEMBRE, ENERO, FEBRERO), from the problem to the result, each with its month tag on top. Bottom 36%: on the left three real bottles in a row with a pink ribbon swirl behind; on the right the offer block in a white rounded card; under them a slim plum strip with 'Pagas al recibir' and the gold-bordered registration badge.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: '3 MESES PARA TUS CURVAS' with 'CURVAS' in fuchsia

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows month-by-month progress; panel 1 is the pain moment
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Same woman, legs and hips in jeans, different outfit, hair and setting each month
Three real closed bottles with a pink ribbon swirl instead of a water splash
Exact batch offer text, no free month and no price

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Cash on delivery and sanitary registration

forbidden_additions: Prices, percentages, discounts, 'gratis' or '1 mes gratis'
Star ratings, customer counts, reviews or names
Loose capsules, pills or an open bottle

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 image ad on a soft lavender #B9A6E0 background with tiny flat white and butter-yellow holiday stars scattered near the edges. TOP ZONE (0-24%): the big centered two-line headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), all caps: line 1 '3 MESES PARA' in dark plum #2B1226, line 2 'TUS CURVAS' where the word 'TUS' is dark plum and the highlighted word 'CURVAS' is hot fuchsia #E6177F. Under it one centered line in Poppins SemiBold, dark plum: 'Piernas torneadas que llenan el jean en tu tratamiento de 3 meses, para lucir tu ropa favorita con seguridad.' MIDDLE ZONE (24-64%): three equal rounded panels side by side with pale blush #FBE3EE fill, each with a butter-yellow #FFE08A rounded tag on top reading 'DICIEMBRE', 'ENERO', 'FEBRERO' in plum Poppins Bold. Inside each panel a flat vector illustration with clean dark outlines of the SAME adult woman, about 22 years old with adult features, light brown (morena clara) skin, long straight black hair, shown full body from head to shoes, facing the viewer or three-quarters, never from behind. Each month is a different day: PANEL DICIEMBRE: in her messy bedroom at night under a small lamp, hair in a high messy bun, an oversized butter-yellow sweatshirt and baggy light-blue jeans that sag, side-on at hip height, one hand pulling the jeans waistband a full fist away from her hip so the empty gap is obvious; thin straight legs lost inside the wide jean legs, flat straight silhouette, sad face. PANEL ENERO: in a kitchen in cool morning light, hair in a low ponytail, a lavender t-shirt and straight-leg medium-blue jeans, facing the viewer with one hand on her waist, a small first change in her legs, calm smile. PANEL FEBRERO: outdoors in a sunny park in warm afternoon light, hair loose and a bit longer, a white strappy top and dark-blue skinny jeans, three-quarter pose with a hand on her hip, big happy smile; a curvy figure: small waist, wider curved hips, toned thicker legs filling the jean legs, the change obvious at a glance without caricature. BOTTOM ZONE (64-92%): on the left half, three real product bottles from the attached product photo standing in a row, the middle one slightly forward, together about 26% of the canvas height, centered in their half with space on both sides so none is cut by the edge, with a flowing pale-pink #FF8CC0 ribbon swirl behind them; use the attached product image as the only source of truth and do not redesign it: a matte black cylindrical bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides, wide mouth and no neck, a glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body (about 90%) and one fifth of its height with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth, black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and three boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'; not a slim bottle, not a squat jar; closed, labels front-facing and never mirrored; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. On the right half, a white rounded card with plum Montserrat ExtraBold text, left-aligned: 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses', and below it a hot fuchsia #E6177F pill button with white Poppins Bold uppercase text 'QUIERO PROBARLO'. VERY BOTTOM STRIP (92-100%): a full-width dark plum #2B1226 strip with a white pill reading 'Pagas al recibir' in plum Poppins Bold on the left and, on the right, a round badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, plum center and white text 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.

mandatory_visual_elements: Three flat illustrated panels of the same adult woman in December, January and February, each with a different outfit, hairstyle, place and light
December panel shows the pain moment: hand pulling the loose waistband away from the hip with the gap visible
February panel shows the clear result: curvy hips and toned legs filling the jeans, facing the viewer or three-quarters
Three real closed bottles centered in the left half, none cut by the edge
Offer card with the fuchsia pill button, and the plum strip with 'Pagas al recibir' and the gold-bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: sin poses de espaldas ni enfoque en zonas del cuerpo
No back views, no close-ups of the buttocks, no lingerie or swimwear
Never the same outfit, pose, hairstyle or setting in two panels
No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle, no water splash with drops on the label
No prices, percentages, discounts, 'gratis', stars, customer counts, reviews or names
No logos outside the bottle label
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add extra buttons, badges, seals or strips beyond the ones described here.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
